summary: Iter42 review: (1) Header Live-Badge click-counting double-click (2 single clicks 100-150ms apart) toggles to IBKR stack (broker-mini='IBKR', balance='nicht eingeloggt') without opening Capital-Modal. dblclick reverses to Bitunix stack; single-click opens Capital modal. localStorage 'kit_live_badge_source' persists across reload. (2) Strategy-Vergleich modal renders without include-collection/include-stale checkboxes; filters ALLE/LIVE/PAPER + Gesamt/30/7 present; empty-state shown. (3) Backend /api/analytics/strategy-comparison forces include_collection=false / include_stale=false; stale_strategies still returned. (4) /api/telegram/notify-config includes 'ibkr_gateway' (bool, default true), POST toggle to false and back to true works with admin auth. (5) Backend unit regression (test_forex_ibkr_live.py, test_iter39_paper_stats_api.py, test_forex_ibkr.py) 39/39 green. (6) /api/ibkr/status 200 with hint/probe; /api/autotrade/balance contains 'ibkr'. (7) SettingsPanel Telegram tab shows label 'IBKR-Gateway: ausgeloggt / readyz länger als 5 Min rot (Forex-Live)' with toggle. All acceptance criteria met.
